newsitem.title: FRANCE: French SNCF railways unit buys British Rail unit.
newsitem.headline: French SNCF railways unit buys British Rail unit.

text.p: PARIS, March 25, Reuter - A subsidiary of France's SNCF state railways said on Tuesday that it had acquired British Rail International Ltd (BRIL), a travel agency subsidiary of British rail, for an undisclosed sum.
SNCF said the purchase had been made by its Grandes Lignes International (GLI) unit, which sells European rail packages throughout the world.
BRIL sells European rail tours in Britain and distributes British Rail products throughout the rest of the world.
BRIL is "clearly profitable" and has an annual turnover of about 750 million Ffr, about half that of GLI, GLI managing director Pierre Reinhardt told Reuters.
He would not disclose the cost of the acquisition but said it was on the order of "a few tens of millions of francs".
The SNCF unit said the acquisition would help it exploit the market for rail tours in both London and Paris, the main entry points for tourists visiting Europe from around the world.
SNCF will now restructure both GLI and BRIL operations to coordinate their activites and develop synergies, Reinhardt said.
